title: Isabuzza and the Secret Sprinkle Honey
summary: Isabuzza is no ordinary worker bee; she is an innovator who concocts a revolutionary honey recipe featuring coconut, kiwi, broccoli, and sprinkles. When darkness falls and the colony can no longer find flowers, Isabuzza steps up to save the day. Performing her signature wiggle dance, she guides her fellow bees to a secret patch of nectar. To officially earn her stripes, Isabuzza must complete her worker bee trials, mastering color-spotting, navigating flying hazards, and buzzing ten distinct pitches. Through her determination and culinary creativity, Isabuzza proves she has what it takes to be a true hero of the hive.
